Leonis X. nomine scrī Leonis decimi nomine scriptræ: quæ pro- pta. pter cùm sententiarū acumen atq; breui- tatem, tùm styli puritate, elegantiam, ve- nustatem verè Ciceroniā legendæ diligen ter sunt ab iis, qui vel regibus atq; princi- pib. vel Rebuspub. aliquādo in cancellis inseruire cupiūt.Nos 24.l.16.imitati able- imitatio māgato à nobis famulo mandabimus, vt co- datoriæ e-missa negotia diligēter &primo quoq; tē- pistolæ Cic.pore expediat:sententiæ esse tales poterūt.
I. Etsi paucos ante dies de omnib. reb.prolixè ad te scripseram:tamē cum certū homine ad vos euntem nactus essem:denuò de iisdem ad te dare literas volui.
II. Non quod de tua diligentia dubitem,quam ha ctenus ego probaui semper:sed quia vei me ita anxiū

page.notes: Marginal notes are small italic references, mostly in the right margin; the Greek word "μεγάλως" at the head of the first line is printed in Greek type and is a best reading ("μεγαλ...") with doubt. Several notes are cut at the page edge and are transcribed as far as legible. The paragraph beginning "I. Etsi" and the last line are rendered with italics as printed; the last line is partly cut off by the gutter and may be incomplete. The word "vei" in the last line is a probable printing error for "vel"/"vt" and is left as printed.
